run_libri_labels_extract: run the script to extract LibriSpeech transcriptions from a TSV file into .ltr and .wrd output files
run_libri_labels_cli: run the CLI tool with a TSV path, output directory, and output name to generate label files
review_main_function: review the main function that parses TSV input and writes letter and word transcription files
summarize_libri_labels_script: summarize the helper script that pre-computes embeddings for a flashlight wav2letter dataset
refactor_transcription_parsing: refactor the transcription file parsing logic to support additional LibriSpeech dataset formats
